issues.detail: The Greek 'υποδησαμενοι τους ποδας' (having shod our feet) is a participle describing an action/state of the subjects. The Vietnamese translation 'là sự sẵn sàng' (is the readiness) turns the phrase into a definition/equality, changing the meaning from 'wearing shoes for the purpose of...' to 'shoes are the readiness'.
